name: Tile Removal & Surface Preparation
short: Existing tile removal, adhesive removal and substrate preparation for a fresh installation.
intro: We remove existing tile and prepare the exposed surface for the next finish. The scope starts with the floor or wall construction, bonded layers, access and the required finished height. We plan dust control, protection, debris handling and suitable patching or flattening before new tile work begins. Concealed damage or materials requiring specialist assessment are identified separately before further work.

faq.q: Can I book tile removal without new installation?
faq.a: Yes. We can quote removal and preparation as a separate scope. Tell us the existing tile area, substrate if known, access route and the finish planned next so we can agree on the condition in which the surface will be left.

faq.q: Does removing tile leave a floor ready for new tile?
faq.a: Not always. Removal can reveal cracks, loose layers, moisture damage or uneven areas. We assess the exposed substrate and confirm the repairs or preparation needed before the next installation.
Debris handling, removal from the property and disposal are identified in the written quote. Building access, elevator bookings, parking and disposal arrangements affect the scope.

scopeHeading: Prepare a sound surface for the next finish.
scopeNote: We agree on protection, removal, debris handling and the required substrate condition before work starts.
projectSummary: We plan removal, protection and preparation around the existing surface and the finish you want next.
imageAlt: Prepared floor substrate with a straightedge beside remaining dark tiles
homeImageAlt: Kitchen renovation with removed terracotta tiles and exposed concrete substrate

guidance.propertyCheck: Identify the substrate, existing layers and any known moisture, movement or concealed services before choosing removal methods.
guidance.accessCheck: Plan dust containment, occupied-area protection, debris routes and building access before work starts.
guidance.seasonalCheck: Maintain suitable conditions for patching and levelling materials, including drying time before the new finish.
failurePoints: Removal damages a substrate intended to remain
Weak adhesive or loose layers are left beneath the next finish
Finished heights, moisture or required flatness are not checked

name: Tile, Grout & Stone Cleaning and Sealing
short: Deep cleaning and suitable sealing treatments for existing tile, grout and natural stone.
intro: We clean existing tiled and stone surfaces using methods matched to the material, finish and type of soiling. Before treatment, we identify the surface and grout, review any previous coating and test a small area where appropriate. Sealing is recommended only for materials that benefit from it. Cleaning and sealing improve care and stain resistance where suitable; they do not repair failed waterproofing, cracks or acid etching.

faq.q: Does every tile or grout need sealing?
faq.a: No. Porcelain, glazed tile, epoxy grout and natural stone have different care requirements. We check the product, finish and absorbency before recommending a sealer, following the relevant manufacturer guidance.

faq.q: Is cleaning the same as regrouting?
faq.a: No. Cleaning treats dirt and residues on existing sound surfaces. Crumbling, missing or damaged grout may need repair or replacement, which is covered by our tile repair and regrouting service.

faq.q: Will sealing make my shower waterproof?
faq.a: No. A suitable sealer can help with stain resistance in absorbent materials, but it does not replace the waterproofing assembly or repair leaks behind the tile.

scopeHeading: Choose the treatment for your tile and stone.

projectSummary: We assess the surface and select a cleaning or sealing treatment suited to its material and condition.

name: Rooftop Terrace & Pedestal Pavers
short: Walkable rooftop terraces with porcelain pavers and raised pedestal systems.
intro: We supply and install pavers for suitable rooftop terraces using a specified support system. Raised pedestals can create a level walking surface above a sloping roof while allowing drainage below and access to service points. We review the roof assembly, approved loading, wind exposure, edge restraint, threshold heights and material handling before finalizing the scope. Structural suitability, roof-membrane compatibility and required building approvals must be confirmed for the property.

faq.q: Are rooftop pavers the same as roofing tiles?
faq.a: No. This service creates a walkable terrace above a suitable roof assembly. It does not cover pitched-roof clay or concrete roofing tiles, or replace the roof waterproofing system.

faq.q: Can pedestal pavers be installed on any flat roof?
faq.a: No. The roof structure, membrane, loading, wind exposure, drainage, thresholds and edge protection must support the proposed terrace. We confirm the applicable design and building requirements before quoting an installation.

faq.q: Can you supply the pavers and pedestals?
faq.a: Yes. We can include suitable pavers and the specified pedestal system in the quote. Quantities, edge details, delivery, unloading and lifting arrangements are agreed for the property.

scopeHeading: Plan the terrace and its support system together.
scopeNote: We confirm the approved assembly, material supply, access, lifting and installation details before work starts.
projectSummary: We coordinate paver supply, pedestal layout and installation around the approved rooftop assembly.
